## Ringkasan

Jelaskan perubahan dan alasan bisnis/teknisnya.

## Traceability

- Closes #
- GitHub Project: `Platform Engineering Delivery`
- Parent Epic:
- Governance reference:
- Target release/milestone:

## Risk dan impact

- Area dan scope:
- Priority:
- Security/data/cost/migration/breaking impact:
- Rollback atau recovery path:

## Validasi

- [ ] Acceptance criteria issue terpenuhi.
- [ ] Required tests dan checks lulus.
- [ ] Dokumentasi dan compatibility diperbarui bila terdampak.
- [ ] Perubahan tidak memuat secret, credential, endpoint internal, atau raw evidence.

## Evidence

Cantumkan safe evidence ID, run URL, immutable SHA/digest, atau alasan `not-applicable`.

## Release impact

Pilih `major`, `minor`, `patch`, `none`, atau `not-applicable` dan jelaskan alasannya.
